title: Theo and the Cover
author: Kestrel Quintana
blurb: Ivo Crane, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
